Name: More Quests
Author: RafiaBee
Description:
[size=4][b]What does this mod do?[/b][/size]

Adds a big batch of new quests. They scale with your skills, react to what your character has done, and pull in NPCs and festivals from Ridgeside, East Scarp, Mount Vapius, SVE, and more.

This mod is just the quests. The behind-the-scenes parts (the bigger Help Wanted board, the rules for when quests show up, the rewards, the NPC reactions) live in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46361]More Quests Framework[/url], which you need to install alongside this mod.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]80+ new quests[/b] across Farming, Fishing, Mining, Foraging, Animal, Cooking, Festival, Seasonal, and Social categories (full list further down)[/*]
[*][b]Help Wanted board overhaul[/b] - several quests per day instead of vanilla's one[/*]
[*][b]New Adventurer's Guild board[/b] at the mine entrance (opt-out in settings). Mining and combat quests live here so the Help Wanted board doesn't get crowded[/*]
[*][b]Cooking quests scale and villagers taste-test[/b] - If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]Love of Cooking[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22681]YACS[/url] installed and have "Difficulty Scaling" enabled in configs, cooking related quests will scale with your cooking skill. Villagers actually react to the dish you cooked (loved / liked / hated)[/*]
[*][b]NPC reactions[/b] - some quests (Massive Harvest, Medium Fishing Haul, Seafood Night, Monster Parts, Saloon Specials) make villagers say something based on what you brought in. The line shows up the next time you talk to them[/*]
[*][b]Works with modded NPCs[/b] - Ridgeside, East Scarp, Mount Vapius, SVE, Eli and Dylan, Arumi the Actress, Sen (Lurking in the Dark), and Gunnar (Bear Fam) NPCs join the quest-giver and reaction pools automatically. I tried my best to exclude non-canon npcs (like The Emperor / Lexi / Krobus / Sen non-human npcs) from the quests, but if some leak through please let me know. Child NPCs (Jas, Vincent, Leo, and any modded child NPCs you've met) are excluded from most boards but they do get one quest of their own: Feed Wild Critters, a small foraging errand. Finish three of those and Marnie gives you a discount on your next pet.[/*]
[*][b]Per-quest toggles[/b] - every quest can be turned off on its own through GMCM[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Quests[/b][/size]
Cooldowns are tunable in the framework config. The defaults are: [b]Short = 2 days[/b], [b]Medium = 7 days[/b], [b]Long = 14 days[/b]. A quest just says "Short", "Medium", or "Long" unless it uses a fixed number. Quests are grouped by category and listed alphabetically within each group. Click a category to expand its list.

[b]How gold rewards work[/b]
The reward line for each quest spells out the gold it pays. There are two kinds.
[b]Flat tier rewards.[/b] Some quests hand you a fixed amount tied to a difficulty tier in the framework config, so you can raise or lower all of them at once. Defaults: Beginner = 100g (GoldBeginnerBase), Basic = 300g (GoldBasicBase), Intermediate = 500g (GoldIntermediateBase), Advanced = 1000g (GoldAdvancedBase), Expert = 3000g (GoldExpertBase).
[b]Sell-price rewards.[/b] Other quests pay based on what you turn in: the item's sell price, times how many you bring, times one of three multipliers (also in the config). The multipliers: 0.8 (below sell, RewardMultiplierBelowSell, a bit under what you'd get selling them yourself), 1.05 (above sell, RewardMultiplierAboveSell, a bit over), and 1.15 (fish premium, RewardMultiplierFishPremium, the best rate, used for big fish hauls).

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, two settings pages show up in-game. Otherwise edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] files in each mod's folder.
[list]
[*][b]MoreQuests config[/b] - the settings for the quests this mod adds, grouped onto category pages: the Adventurer's Guild board (on/off, how many quests it shows, and where it sits), shop discount sizes, item quantities, Skull Cavern max floor, the secret-gift hint, a never-reward item list, plus its own pages for the Redecorate quest and for the mod-compatibility ids.[/*]
[*][b]MoreQuestsFramework config[/b] - the engine-level stuff shared by any mod built on it: how many quests show up per day, which quest types are on or off, quest consequences on/off, deadline and cooldown lengths, gold tiers, friendship reward sizes, consequence grace window, per-quest weights.[/*]
[/list]Both pages also have an [b]Advanced > Debug logging[/b] toggle at the bottom. Leave it off for normal play, flip it on if you hit a bug and need to share a SMAPI log.

[/list]You can install or remove quests mid-playthrough. Save data only stores currently active quests. If you face any issues, please let me know!

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] untested. Tested on single-player only.[/*]
[*][b]Not compatible with any other Help Wanted mod, or any mod that directly modifies the Help Wanted board.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Mail Services Mod:[/b] works. Mailing a quest item through the mailbox pays exactly the quest's reward, multi-step deliver quests can be handed in by mail too, and mailed gifts count toward gift quests like Forage of the Valley.[/*]
[*][b]Friendship-decay / friendship-clamp mods (CJB Cheats Menu's "No friendship decay", [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22922]No Friendship Decay - Reborn[/url] etc.):[/b] block the negative side of consequence reactions on Massive Harvest, Weekly Specials, Medium Fishing Haul, Seafood Night, and Monster Parts. The positive friendship side still works. Turn that option off if you want the full consequence aspect of the quests.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size]
This mod supports translations! Please feel free to translate the mod to your language and upload to Nexus on your own page. Nexus will automatically link it to this mod.
